label: Nivolumab SC (Opdivo Qvantig) — Zhao 2025 pooled IV+SC model · 2-compartment · time-varying CL
_note: Pre-specified pooled model: 18 IV studies plus the 66 SC patients (with rHuPH20) of CheckMate-8KX, many tumour types. Converted from hours to days.

_source.document: Zhao et al. 2025, CPT Pharmacometrics Syst Pharmacol 14:2107-2117 (doi:10.1002/psp4.70120, PMC12706396)
_source.table: Table S2 (parameters), File S1 (NONMEM code), Table 1 (population); exposures from the FDA review Table 6
_source.subjects: 3554 patients (3488 IV in 18 studies, 66 SC in CheckMate-8KX)

limitations: Between-subject variability on Emax (ω² 0.0519) is omitted because the engine does not support it.

The CL and Q unit label (mL/hr) in the paper's Table S2 is an error; following the code and the FDA table, they were read as L/h. The reference weight likewise uses the code's 80 kg instead of the table footnote's 75 kg.
With only 66 SC patients, the absorption-related values (ka, F) are highly uncertain (RSE 7% for F, 26% for its between-subject variability).

The validation values are observed geometric means from small 8KX cohorts (a few dozen patients per part) and are compared against a single representative patient. Values reported without variability use ±10% as the criterion, which is strict.
Time units were converted from hours (h) to days.
